exact-declaration-inventory.text: All forty-one declarations are proved. Every statement keeps the text and digest it was frozen with. The source-derived checker verifies exact identities and statement hashes and derives each status from the proof text. A compiled gate collects the axioms of every theorem while the library builds and fails the build if any depends on sorry or an axiom outside the standard three. Re-admitting one theorem was shown to turn the build red.

inversions-and-statement-domain.text: All inversions are proved. The reachable-state obligations go through an invariant stronger than well-formed supply: every custody record carries the current representative of its key, and every custody identifier is recorded and unique. A general statement that terminal request custody can leave only through completion is still missing.
